mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0%), or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 indicates a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate capital expenditure and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during a supply-side contraction regime.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 95.0), or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 3.0% signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 3.0), or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with GDPC1 growth > 2.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending power and corporate hiring, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) reading below 95.5 indicates a significant slowdown in manufacturing output that reduces corporate capital investment and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 95.5), or the Rank IC is negative over any 6-month rolling window.
